# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes go into the latest release of `create-mercury` and into the template on `main`. Older versions don't get fixes, so upgrade to the latest release first.

Projects that were already created from Mercury don't update themselves. When a fix affects the template, the release notes say which files to change in an existing project.

## Report a vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/arvemy/mercury/security/advisories/new). Don't open a public issue, pull request, or discussion about it.

Include:

- what is affected, such as the `create-mercury` CLI, a template file, or the release workflow
- the version of `create-mercury`, or the commit of `main`
- steps to reproduce, or a proof of concept
- the impact you expect

You get a reply in the private advisory. A fix is released first, then the advisory is published with credit to you, unless you ask to stay anonymous.
